items.name: app-launch
items.title: App launch film
items.description: A 21 second launch film for an app, in six beats: a typed question, a chat bar drawn on by guide lines, a wall of screens, and a closing mark.

items.name: archive
items.title: Archive
items.description: Period photographs drift in layers under film flicker and dust, with typed dates and captions.

items.name: area-chart
items.title: Area chart
items.description: A gradient area draws in under a trucking camera and lands on a tooltip. Light or dark.

items.name: audio-plasma
items.title: Audio plasma
items.description: A white-hot trace glows inside blue copies, with the running time in huge soft numerals. It is drawn from the audio file itself.

items.name: audio-scope
items.title: Audio scope
items.description: An oscilloscope draws the sound as red and yellow traces over a dark grid. It is drawn from the audio file itself.

items.name: aurora
items.title: Aurora ribbons
items.description: Ribbons of light drift and are blended so that overlaps never blow out. It loops with no join at whole-number speeds.

items.name: aurora-veil
items.title: Aurora veil
items.description: Skewed curtains of colour drift in from the top-right corner. It loops with no join.

items.name: bar-chart
items.title: Bar chart
items.description: Bars grow in turn, then focus racks and the camera pushes in on the winner. A small gap between bars makes it a histogram.

items.name: blueprint
items.title: Blueprint
items.description: White line art draws itself on a Prussian-blue cyanotype sheet, with dimension lines, hatching, typed labels and one red stamp.

items.name: build-out
items.title: Send button zoom-out
items.description: A send button zooms out to show the whole app around it.

items.name: candlestick-chart
items.title: Candlestick chart
items.description: Candles print one by one while the camera rides the newest through a breakout.

items.name: card-rail
items.title: Card rail
items.description: Portrait cards sit on a tilted plane and are flicked along it in two throws, each with a label.

items.name: checkout-push
items.title: Checkout push
items.description: A phone checkout where the amount lands and the camera pushes in.

items.name: circle-carousel-1
items.title: Growing circle carousel
items.description: Square covers sit on a ring that grows from tiny to large as it turns.

items.name: circle-carousel-2
items.title: Spiral carousel
items.description: Covers wind inward on a spiral. They are born at the rim and swallowed at the centre.

items.name: circle-carousel-3
items.title: U-shaped carousel
items.description: Covers are filed into a U and sit askew, like prints that have been handled.

items.name: collage
items.title: Collage
items.description: Paper cut-outs and torn labels sit over an old newspaper page and move in stop motion.

items.name: collage-burst
items.title: Screenshot card burst
items.description: A wordmark fades in on black, then a cluster of screenshot cards bursts out of one point as the camera flies in. The cards settle into a dense wall, drift, and whip off to the right. Big white type finishes it: two short lines, each starting as a single word.

items.name: donut-chart
items.title: Donut chart
items.description: One sweep draws the segments, then the leading segment steps out with a callout. Light or dark.

items.name: dostoevsky
items.title: History explainer
items.description: A 39 second history explainer in the collage taste: dolly-throughs on old maps, taped photos on kraft paper, posters, a portrait montage, and clouds over a city plan. The pictures are public domain.

items.name: dot-field
items.title: Halftone dot field
items.description: A grid of halftone dots breathes on a ring-shaped wave. It loops with no join at whole-number speeds.

items.name: drift-gradient
items.title: Drift gradient
items.description: Soft pools of blue and cyan drift like defocused light through water. It loops with no join.

items.name: explainer
items.title: Explainer
items.description: Cut-out objects on textured paper under big type, with one colour for the key word and quick wipes between beats.

items.name: film-burn
items.title: Film burn transition
items.description: A heat front scorches the first picture and reveals the second.

items.name: film-intro
items.title: Film opening
items.description: An old film fades up as a field of soft ink dots and pushes slowly in. A thin serif line types itself across it, lifts away in a blur, and a second line follows before a title.

items.name: funnel-chart
items.title: Funnel chart
items.description: A funnel blooms stage by stage as the camera moves down it and each number counts up.

items.name: gallery-push
items.title: Gallery wall push-in
items.description: A wall of photo columns unrolls from the middle while the camera pushes in.

items.name: glass-lens
items.title: Glass lens
items.description: A glass ball moves over the picture and refracts what is behind it.

items.name: grain-flow
items.title: Grain flow
items.description: Sheets of cobalt light flow past a navy valley under film grain. It loops with no join.

items.name: grain-gradient
items.title: Grain gradient
items.description: A mesh gradient drifts under film grain. It loops with no join at whole-number speeds.

items.name: graph-paper-tall
items.title: Graph paper
items.description: A faint squared grid on off-white paper that fades towards the edges, cut tall for phones. It loops with no join.

items.name: greeting-intro
items.title: App window greeting
items.description: A gradient wordmark on a soft off-white ground shrinks away as an app window grows in behind it. The camera pushes into the window, tilted, and types a greeting and a question in large perspective type. Four suggestion cards slide in, then the camera pulls back and flattens to the whole window.

items.name: grid-center-orient
items.title: Photo rosette
items.description: A grid in which every card turns to point at the centre. The twist travels outward into a rosette while the camera rolls and pushes in.

items.name: grid-face-screen
items.title: Photo ring facing the screen
items.description: A carousel ring where every card turns to face the screen. It steps one card at a time with a rest between steps, while the camera lifts and closes in.

items.name: grid-forward-orient
items.title: Photo ring facing forward
items.description: A ring of cards on a tilted turntable, each turned to face the way it travels. The camera orbits and closes in during one slow stroke.

items.name: grid-path
items.title: Photos along a curve
items.description: Upright photo cards follow a curve: a wave, a triangle, a square or an infinity sign. The line draws on, the leading card sets off, and the camera trucks along the line.

items.name: grid-path-orient
items.title: Photo loop on a triangle
items.description: Cards ride a rounded triangle, each turned to the direction of the path. The camera looks down and orbits as the cards swing through the corners.

items.name: grid-radial
items.title: Photo rings
items.description: Three concentric rings of photos at different depths open from the centre. The camera swings side to side, then pushes in as focus racks from the inner ring to the outer one.

items.name: grid-rect
items.title: Rectangular photo grid
items.description: A wall of photo cards ripples in from the middle card, then the camera pulls back, trucks across and pushes in on a new card.

items.name: grid-reel
items.title: Grid opener
items.description: A 3 by 3 grid sits over every shot. The cells flash white and come sharp one by one while words land in them. A cut-out subject then stands over changing backgrounds, and the grid opens on a wordmark card.

items.name: grid-spherical
items.title: Photo sphere
items.description: Cards sit tangent to a sphere. It assembles from its centre and turns a full orbit, then settles on one hero card and pushes in.

items.name: halation
items.title: Halation
items.description: A red-orange halo round the bright parts of a picture, with film grain on top.

items.name: heatmap-chart
items.title: Heatmap chart
items.description: A year of activity lights up week by week, then the camera leans in on the busiest day.

items.name: hex-tally
items.title: Hexagon tally
items.description: A unit chart of hexagons fills in beside a metric card that counts up.

items.name: kinetograph-taste-clone
items.title: Taste Clone
items.description: Agent skill: clone a reel or reference video 1:1, or distil its style into a taste. Installed with `npx kinetograph skills update`.

items.name: laptop-open
items.title: Laptop opening
items.description: A 3D laptop lid opens, the screen wakes, and the camera moves into the app.

items.name: launch-film
items.title: Launch film
items.description: A twenty-second product launch film, from a typed headline to the final mark.

items.name: light-leak
items.title: Light leak
items.description: A warm, streaked leak of light from one edge. It can cover a cut between two clips.

items.name: line-ticker
items.title: Line ticker
items.description: A climbing line with the camera chasing its head and a large live number above it. Light or dark.

items.name: liquid-gradient
items.title: Liquid gradient
items.description: A plum, crimson and amber gradient swirls and settles. It loops with no join.

items.name: orbit-gallery
items.title: Orbit gallery
items.description: Nine photos spiral in around a title and settle on an ellipse.

items.name: paper
items.title: Paper texture
items.description: A paper height field lit by a raking light that circles slowly. It loops with no join at whole-number speeds.

items.name: papercut
items.title: Papercut
items.description: A toy-like paper diorama of cut-paper characters and props, with the camera circling the set.

items.name: phone-orbit
items.title: Social post on a phone
items.description: A phone showing a social post starts as a close-up of its lower edge, pulls back and glides to rest. Chat bubbles, avatars and icon chips pop in around it. A hand reaches into the photo and lifts the phone, and the screen swaps to a second one as the view count reaches its cap.

items.name: phone-pitch
items.title: Phone with a pitch
items.description: A headline, a line of body text and a button sit beside a phone that lands with a settle.

items.name: print
items.title: Print
items.description: Flat inks print in turn over paper, with a dot screen that jumps and a slight misregistration.

items.name: prompt-intro
items.title: Prompt intro
items.description: An arrow shrinks and slides left, a prompt types on beside it, then deletes itself into the next line under a blue flash. The answer types on and everything drops out for the cut.

items.name: prompt-reply
items.title: Chat prompt to reply
items.description: A chat prompt types itself into a rounded box and sends. The shot cuts to the reply, built on a page the camera scrolls through. Two activity rows, a status line, a serif reply, a brand chip, a small table and a row of action icons fade up one after another.

items.name: radar-chart
items.title: Radar chart
items.description: A radar chart fills in axis by axis as the camera circles it, then a second series springs open.

items.name: recap-dial
items.title: Year recap dial
items.description: A year in review on a dial that snaps month by month, with a sticker for each.

items.name: reel-wall
items.title: Spinning card ring
items.description: A 3D ring of tall cards spins to rest on one, which steps forward with its name.

items.name: ring-chart
items.title: Ring chart
items.description: Rings fill one at a time with the camera riding each head, then it pulls back on the whole chart.

items.name: sankey-chart
items.title: Sankey chart
items.description: The camera follows the strongest flow, then every other link draws in around it.

items.name: save-reel
items.title: App save reel
items.description: A 39 second app reel: a post is liked and saved, the save gets lost in the collection, and a reminder brings it back. Flat screens on a pale canvas, a camera that whips between details, and hand-written notes.

items.name: scatter-bloom
items.title: Scatter bloom
items.description: Points bloom onto a plane in coloured groups. The camera then tips and orbits to show their heights.

items.name: scrapline
items.title: Scrapline cut-outs
items.description: A hand-drawn border round a cut-out subject, on a sheet of torn paper. The line can be a wobbly marker, pencil, crayon, scribble or brush. Line and paper redraw a few times a second, like hand animation.

items.name: screen-touch
items.title: Touch to the next screen
items.description: A finger presses a button and the next screen opens outward from the touch point.

items.name: screen-tunnel
items.title: Phone tunnel
items.description: Phones recede down a corridor on either side of a headline.

items.name: showcase-drift
items.title: Work card drift
items.description: Cards of work slide in behind a headline and settle without a bounce.

items.name: stack-credits
items.title: Stacked credits
items.description: Three stacked double-exposure panels on black, two shots cut hard, credits fading in and a film burn out. Made tall, for phones.

items.name: tally-rise
items.title: Currency counter
items.description: A currency amount rolls up like an odometer, its wheels locking from left to right.

items.name: three-phone
items.title: Three phones fanned out
items.description: Three tilted phones fan out on an arc from the centre one. Each screen is drawn in, or is your own image.

items.name: tide-gradient
items.title: Tide gradient
items.description: Pools of cyan, mint and steel blue swell and sink into black. It loops with no join.

items.name: vault-count
items.title: Wallet count-up
items.description: A wallet balance counts up beside a stack of payment cards.

items.name: vox-style
items.title: Vox style
items.description: Tinted, halftoned photos on grid paper, caps that fill yellow, and numbers that roll like an odometer.

items.name: wait-ship
items.title: Two lines on a focus pull
items.description: Seven photo cards float round the edges of a near-black frame, out of focus. The camera pulls back and racks focus. A first line comes up out of the blur and a second line replaces it. The scene slides off to the right as the left card sharpens.

items.name: word-flash
items.title: Words cut to the beat
items.description: A 9.4 second black-and-white type spot, cut on every hit of its track. Each cut shows one word or a two-word lockup on a ground that flips between black and white. A last word types on, then blurs away.
